categories.label: Structure
categories.rubric: Judge balance, branch support, spacing, and overall form from the evidence packet.

categories.label: Resin
categories.rubric: Judge the fictional sample's visible gland coverage and consistency from the evidence packet.

categories.label: Terps
categories.rubric: Judge aroma clarity, definition, and complexity as described in the fictional notes.

categories.label: Yield
categories.rubric: Judge the fictional entry's recorded output relative to the rest of this game deck.

categories.label: Color
categories.rubric: Judge visual contrast, consistency, and presentation rather than preferring a specific hue.

categories.label: Documentation
categories.rubric: Judge how complete, traceable, and useful the fictional observation record is.

categories.label: Problem Solving
categories.rubric: Judge whether the fictional grower observed, tested, documented, and corrected a problem logically.
